programmes.programName: Programme of Doctoral Studies, School of Economics
programmes.evidence: The official 2026–27 School of Economics guide, section 6 Doctoral Studies (printed p. 95; PDF p. 94), lists Διοίκησης Παραγωγής και επιχειρησιακών λειτουργιών, literally Production and Operations Management, among named research fields of its doctoral studies programme. The current school doctoral page confirms the doctoral programme leads to a Doctoral Diploma based on original research; the university central PhD page describes the award as Doctoral Diploma (PhD). This is a named doctoral research field within Economics, not a separately titled PhD diploma.
limitations: The official title is preserved in Greek; Operations Management is an English rendering of επιχειρησιακών λειτουργιών in this programme context.
No individual OM List faculty degree or career is verified by this programme-level observation.

branches.conclusion: Current School of Economics doctoral programme and 2026–27 study guide explicitly identify Production and Operations Management as a doctoral research field. Other formal business doctoral scopes are not fully inventoried.

Mechanical Engineering offers a PhD and has an Industrial Management department, neither an exact qualifying title. Its formal doctoral specializations and other technical doctoral areas remain to review.
